canonical_source.behavior: Load the requested retained site-operation record for the authenticated tenant, derive site display context from authoritative tenant-owned data, fail closed for unavailable or cross-tenant identifiers, and perform no mutation.

laravel_adaptation.tenant_isolation: auth + tenant.context + explicit route-tenant match + tenant-scoped SiteOperationHistory query
laravel_adaptation.not_found: Invalid UUID, unavailable record, foreign tenant and cross-tenant correlation identifiers fail closed as 404.
laravel_adaptation.error_state: Retained-history storage/read failure renders a dedicated 503 state with a Retry link bound to the same canonical LoadAsync operation; it is not presented as not-found.

security_boundary.tenant_context: tenant.context activates the authenticated tenant membership and the controller rejects route-tenant mismatch
security_boundary.permission: execution.view is re-authorized before the read
security_boundary.foreign_tenant: focused feature coverage proves foreign tenant and cross-tenant correlation GUID reads return 404
security_boundary.secret_non_exposure: retained operation details are redacted before rendering
security_boundary.direct_object_identifier: correlation UUID is resolved only inside active tenant scope

acceptance_tests: variants/laravel-aiwmweb/backend/tests/Feature/SiteOperationDetailsRouteTerminalityTest.php — binds AIMW-BILL-B26D5099F8 to the real tenant-scoped read, proves no persistence mutation, authoritative rendering, redaction, and guest/permission/foreign-tenant/cross-tenant fail-closed behavior.

terminality.basis: The canonical LoadAsync behavior is backed by the real tenant-scoped retained operation-history read, renders authoritative data without mutation, distinguishes unavailable records from storage/read failures, and preserves the source fail-closed security boundary.
